# hetznerrobot_reset (Data Source)

Reads the reset options of a dedicated server and, where Robot can tell, its operating status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_reset" "web" {
  server_number = 321
}

output "reset_types" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_reset.web.types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server to read.

### Read-Only

- `operating_status` (String) Operating status, e.g. `running`, or `not supported`.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net of the server.
- `types` (List of String) Reset types the server supports (`sw`, `hw`, `man`, `power`, `power_long`).
